source: Not a book section. The one-game-across-modules shape follows CodeHS's project modules in Introduction to Game Design and AP CSA's class units. Structure only: no CodeHS text, problems or code is copied.

lessons.title: Count the cost, and draw the classes
lessons.objective: Students will be able to count what parallel arrays cost in their own code, run the three-question checklist on bullet, enemy and spawner, and plan what each class remembers and does.

lessons.title: Refactor: Enemy, Bullet and Spawner
lessons.objective: Students will be able to move a working game's rules into Enemy, Bullet and Spawner classes without changing what it does, remove finished objects in one place, and reset a class variable on restart.

lessons.title: Playtest, check, add sound, and make it yours
lessons.objective: Students will be able to playtest the rebuilt game, link what they saw to a class, compare the class version with the procedural one, play sound effects from inside the classes' own methods, and extend it with a rule of their own.
